name: input-router
description: Routes large file reads and connector/tool outputs through Haiku (or Sonnet) so only task-relevant findings and exact references reach the main chat; tracks token savings.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Route large inputs through the summarizer. Also toggled with /input-router on|off.

model.title: Summarizer model
model.description: Model that extracts the relevant parts of a large input.

thresholdTokens.title: Threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: Inputs estimated above this many tokens (about 4 characters each) are routed.

tools.title: Routed tools
tools.description: Comma-separated tool names; a trailing * matches a prefix (mcp__* is every connector). Add Bash, Grep or WebSearch to route those too.

maxSummaryTokens.title: Summary cap (tokens)
maxSummaryTokens.description: Upper bound on the summarizer's reply.

stripKeys.title: Extra keys to strip
stripKeys.description: Optional regular expression; JSON fields whose key matches are removed by the pre-filter, on top of the built-in avatar/image/metadata rules.
